description: Read-only cold-page report (GH #497 milestone 1): pages in the caller's own wiki last modified before olderThanDays (default 90) with zero search_relevance_signals engagement since that cutoff, sorted coldest-first. Surfaces candidates only — does not archive or delete. Falls back to age-only results with signalsAvailable:false if the signals table is unreachable or Postgres search is not configured.
name: stale_pages
